en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a narrow rocky passage or cleft, with rough rock walls on both sides and a dirt- and stone-covered ground. A thin tree trunk stands in the middle distance beyond the rocks. The image has a white border typical of vintage postcards. In the lower right corner there is a handwritten signature/date and printed caption reading "Brudsängen, Brobacken."
